title: leucanthemum virgatum
intro: Leucanthemum virgatum, commonly known as the White Woodland Daisy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum virgatum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
